issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Humalike x GTA RP
products.tagline: AI NPCs that talk, remember & act on their own
products.summaryZh: 能对话、有记忆、自主行动的AI NPC
products.descriptionZh: 全新的角色扮演体验。在波兰最大的角色扮演服务器上，构建拥有记忆、个性和声音的角色及完整AI社会，它们能识别玩家、建立关系并对周围一切做出反应。现在，将它加入你的世界。
products.description: A new roleplay experience. Build characters and entire AI societies with memory, personality and voice that recognize players, form relationships and react to everything around them. Live on Poland's largest roleplay server. Now, add it to yours.

products.name: GPT-6 Sol & Luna
products.tagline: Frontier AI intelligence, now at half the price
products.summaryZh: 前沿人工智能情报，现在价格减半
products.descriptionZh: OpenAI 扩展 GPT-6 系列，推出 Sol 和 Luna，模型训练方式与 Astra 类似，速度更快、成本更低。API 价格降低 50%，在事实准确性、编程和计算机使用方面接近 Astra 的提升，提示缓存更优（缓存读取费用减免 90%），对齐也有所改进。现已在 ChatGPT Work、Codex 和 API 中上线。
products.description: OpenAI expands the GPT-6 family with Sol and Luna with faster, cheaper models trained like Astra. 50% lower API pricing, near-Astra factuality/coding/computer use gains, better prompt caching (90% off cached reads), and alignment improvements. Live in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and via API.

products.name: Cuey
products.tagline: Compare ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini answers in one tab.
products.summaryZh: 在一个标签页中比较ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini的回答。
products.descriptionZh: AI会用同样自信的语气给出错误答案，就像给出正确答案时一样。Cuey将你的AI答案与ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini及其他30多个模型进行交叉验证，标出它们不一致的地方以及你的模型遗漏的内容。无需在标签页之间复制粘贴，无需重复输入，无需额外订阅。在被第一个答案坑到之前，先获取第二意见。
products.description: AI gives you wrong answers in the same confident tone as right ones. Cuey cross-checks your AI's answer against ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and 30+ other models. It surfaces where they disagree and what your model missed. No copy-pasting between tabs, no repeating yourself, no extra subscriptions. Get a second opinion before you get burned by the first.

products.name: Superhuman Go
products.tagline: The AI assistant that works where you do
products.summaryZh: 在你工作的地方为你服务的AI助手
products.descriptionZh: Go 可在 Gmail、Slack、你的文档和浏览器中运行，帮你优化措辞、起草符合你风格的回复，并在你想到之前就准备好会议。添加按自身计划运行的无代码代理。免费开始。
products.description: Go works inside Gmail, Slack, your docs, and your browser nudging better phrasing, drafting replies that sound like you, and prepping meetings before you think to. Add no-code agents that run on their own schedule. Free to start.

products.name: KiwiDesk
products.tagline: Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS.
products.summaryZh: 平铺窗口的感觉就像macOS自带的一样。
products.descriptionZh: KiwiDesk 是一款 macOS 平铺窗口管理器，让你的 Mac 保持井然有序：每个窗口都能在七种布局中找到自己的位置，应用可通过快捷键打开，鼠标用户则有一个可拖放窗口的 Space Bar。它与 macOS 原生桌面空间协同工作：为每个桌面空间绑定一个配置文件，当你滑动到该空间时便会自动加载，拥有各自的空间、布局、颜色和快捷键。所有设置都在原生设置应用中完成，无需配置文件。免费使用，源码托管于 GitHub。
products.description: KiwiDesk is a tiling window manager for macOS that keeps your Mac calm and organized: every window finds its place in one of seven layouts, apps open with a shortcut, and mouse users get a Space Bar they can drag windows onto. It works with your native macOS Desktops: bind a profile to each one and it loads the moment you swipe there, with its own spaces, layouts, colors and shortcuts. Everything is set in a native Settings app, no config file needed. Free to use, source on GitHub.

products.name: Harmony
products.tagline: AI agents that resolve IT/HR tickets inside Slack and Teams
products.summaryZh: 在Slack和Teams内解决IT/HR工单的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: Harmony 是面向 IT 团队的 AI 原生 ITSM 平台。我们不是在工单工具上外挂一个聊天机器人，而是围绕 AI 智能体构建帮助台：员工在 Slack 或 Teams 中提问，100 多个生产就绪的智能体端到端处理密码重置、应用访问、入职、设备问题等，仅在需要时升级给人工。工单、资产清单、SaaS 管理和工作流集中在一个工作区，让智能体拥有采取行动所需的上下文。团队可在数天内实现 60% 以上的自动解决率。
products.description: Harmony is an AI-native ITSM platform for IT teams. Instead of bolting a chatbot onto a ticketing tool, we built the helpdesk around AI agents: employees ask in Slack or Teams, and 100+ production-ready agents handle password resets, app access, onboarding, device issues and more end to end, escalating to a human only when needed. Ticketing, asset inventory, SaaS management and workflows live in one workspace, so agents have context to act. Teams hit 60%+ auto-resolution in days.

products.name: NiroHelp
products.tagline: Save time and money with AI-native support for WordPress
products.summaryZh: 借助原生AI支持为WordPress节省时间和成本
products.descriptionZh: 用更小的团队和更低的成本支持更多客户。NiroHelp 的 AI 利用你的文档在聊天中回答客户问题，并自动回复支持工单。客户能更快得到答案，你的团队则减少在重复性问题上的时间。当 AI 不确定时，由你的团队接手。一切都在 WordPress 内完成。
products.description: Support more customers with a smaller team and lower costs. NiroHelp’s AI uses your docs to answer customer questions in chat and reply to support tickets automatically. Customers get faster answers, while your team spends less time on repetitive questions. When AI is unsure, your team takes over. All inside WordPress.

products.name: Lofi Cities
products.tagline: Pixel-art city nights with endless, browser-generated lofi
products.summaryZh: 像素风城市夜景，搭配浏览器生成的无限低保真音乐
products.descriptionZh: 探索16座动画像素艺术城市，无尽lofi音乐在浏览器中实时创作。可从9种音乐风格中选择，切换天气，混合城市音效，设置专注或睡眠定时器。查看城市中有多少人，发送漂浮反应，一起放飞灯笼。参加城市导览或在手机上探索。免费，无需账户，首次访问后可离线使用。
products.description: Explore 16 animated pixel-art cities with endless lofi composed live in your browser. Choose from 9 music styles, change the weather, mix city sounds, and set focus or sleep timers. See how many people are in your city, send floating reactions, and release lanterns together. Take a city tour or explore on your phone. Free, no account needed, and works offline after your first visit.

products.name: QuotaMint
products.tagline: Stop rebuilding credits and usage limits.
products.summaryZh: 停止重建积分和使用限制。
products.descriptionZh: QuotaMint 通过一个简单的 API，帮助 SaaS、AI 和 API 产品管理积分、使用限额、套餐、功能访问和使用跟踪。它可与 Stripe、Paddle、Dodo Payments 或你现有的计费系统配合使用，让你继续掌控支付，而 QuotaMint 负责管理用户可以访问和消耗的内容。它为快速集成而构建，包含测试和生产环境、幂等使用跟踪、原子积分扣减以及清晰的使用历史。
products.description: QuotaMint helps SaaS, AI, and API products manage credits, usage limits, plans, feature access, and usage tracking with one simple API. It works alongside Stripe, Paddle, Dodo Payments, or your existing billing setup, so you keep control of payments while QuotaMint handles what users can access and consume. Built for fast integration, it includes Test and Live environments, idempotent usage tracking, atomic credit deduction, and clear usage history.

products.name: OpenScience
products.tagline: The open-source AI workbench for scientific research
products.summaryZh: 面向科学研究的开源 AI 工作台
products.descriptionZh: OpenScience 是一个用于科学研究的开源 AI 智能体。它能阅读论文，编写并运行代码，可在 notebook 和终端中工作，并将长时间运行的任务发送到 Modal、你自己的服务器或 Slurm/PBS 集群。给它一个指标，Autoresearch 就会运行实验、记录每一次实验，并持续进行爬山优化。通过一个钱包使用 30 多种模型，使用 ChatGPT 登录，或运行本地模型。它在智能体科学研究基准测试中排名第一。免费且开源。
products.description: OpenScience is an open-source AI agent for scientific research. It reads papers, writes and runs code, works in notebooks and a terminal, and sends long jobs to Modal, your own servers, or a Slurm/PBS cluster. Give it a metric and Autoresearch runs experiments, logs every one, and keeps hill-climbing. Use 30+ models through one wallet, sign in with ChatGPT, or run a local model. It ranks #1 on agentic scientific research benchmarks. Free and open source.

products.name: Greypaint
products.tagline: Every Mac app up to date, with an undo button
products.summaryZh: 每款Mac应用保持最新，还带撤销按钮
products.descriptionZh: Greypaint 为 Mac 上的应用查找更新，来源包括 App Store、Homebrew 以及各应用自带的更新器，一键即可安装。每次更新在安装前都会经过检查，如果新版本导致问题，你可以回滚。一次性付费 6.49 美元。
products.description: Greypaint finds updates for the apps on your Mac, from the App Store, Homebrew and each app’s own updater, and installs them in one click. Every update is checked before it lands, and if a new version breaks something, you can roll back. $6.49, once.

products.name: Robin
products.tagline: An inbox that organises itself
products.summaryZh: 一个能自我整理的收件箱
products.descriptionZh: Robin 为你提供一个能自我整理的电子邮箱。用它来注册账号或转发邮件：登录验证码直达你手边，购物和订阅自动归类，邀请函直接进入你的日历。像杂志一样汇集你所有的新闻邮件。关键在于让你从邮件中解放出来。智能代理应在后台与收件箱协同工作，为我们服务。收件箱理应默认更智能。
products.description: Robin gives you an email inbox that organises itself. Use it for signups or forward your mail: login codes reach you, purchases and subscriptions get classified, and invitations land in your calendar. Gathers all your newsletter like a magazine. The point is liberating from email a bit. Agents should work in the background with the inbox for us. Inbox should be smarter by default.

products.name: Layoutr
products.tagline: Your floor plan, in 3D, then rendered by AI
products.summaryZh: 你的户型图，以3D呈现，再由AI渲染
products.descriptionZh: 上传或绘制你自己的户型图，设定比例，并在上面摆放真实尺寸的家具。然后将同一平面图提升至3D：从上方以真实墙高查看娃娃屋模式，或在视线高度进入内部模式，让你可以在其中穿行。框选一个视角，命名一种风格，AI便会将你的房间渲染成照片级逼真的图像。
products.description: Upload or draw your own floor plan, set the scale, and place real-sized furniture on it. Then lift the same plan into 3D: Dollhouse mode from above with your real wall height, or Inside mode at eye level so you can walk through it. Frame a view, name a style, and AI renders your room as a photorealistic image.

products.name: Peas and Pans
products.tagline: Meal plans for nutrition coaches, sent under your own brand
products.summaryZh: 为营养教练提供的膳食计划，以您自己的品牌发送
products.descriptionZh: 从链接、照片、PDF 或文本导入食谱。每种食材都会与 USDA FoodData Central 匹配；不确定的条目会为你标记出来。将餐食拖入客户的每周计划，查看每日总计与目标的对比。将其作为页面和 PDF 发送，并附上你的标志。
products.description: Import a recipe from a link, photo, PDF or text. Each ingredient is matched to USDA FoodData Central; uncertain lines are flagged for you. Drag meals into a client's week and see day totals against their targets. Send it as a page and PDF with your logo on it.

products.name: ShipWithMuse
products.tagline: Discover what people are building with Muse
products.summaryZh: 了解人们正在用Muse构建什么
products.descriptionZh: 精选收录 1,000 多个真实 Muse 构建、实验、工具、连接器、技能和用例的目录。可按类别、来源和构建类型搜索与浏览，每个条目都链接回其原始帖子、代码库、视频或网站。
products.description: A curated catalog of 1,000+ real Muse builds, experiments, tools, connectors, skills, and use cases. Search and browse by category, source, and build type, with every entry linked back to its original post, repo, video, or site.

products.name: Clicks Communicator
products.tagline: A new kind of mobile communicator designed for doing
products.summaryZh: 一种专为行动设计的新型移动通讯器
products.descriptionZh: Clicks Communicator 是一款紧凑型 Android 17 手机，围绕物理键盘和对话主屏幕设计。它既可作为主力机，也可作为备用机，支持完整 5G 和各类应用，让消息、打字和快捷回复触手可及。
products.description: Clicks Communicator is a compact Android 17 phone built around a physical keyboard and a home screen for conversations. Use it as your main phone or a companion, with full 5G and apps while keeping messages, typing, and quick replies close at hand.

products.name: QueroCura
products.tagline: the future of connected healthcare
products.summaryZh: 互联医疗的未来
products.descriptionZh: 个性化护理，就在家中。从了解您的症状到记住下一次用药，QueroCura将您的健康历程汇聚于一个值得信赖的地方。
products.description: Personalized care, right at home. From understanding your symptoms to remembering your next dose, QueroCura keeps your health story in one trusted place.

products.name: GameRoll: Game Backlog Tracker
products.tagline: One app for your gaming life.
products.summaryZh: 一个应用，满足你的游戏生活。
products.descriptionZh: GameRoll 将你的游戏生活汇聚一处。从当代主机到经典复古系统：在一个应用中追踪横跨 200 多个平台的游戏库。整理你的待玩游戏和愿望单，为游戏评分和撰写评测，发现热门和高分作品，并用 Your Roll 决定接下来玩什么。关注玩家、加入社区、讨论游戏，并分享你在网上任何地方发现的游戏。GameRoll 是你所玩一切的家。
products.description: GameRoll brings your gaming life into one place. From current-gen consoles to classic retro systems: track your library spanning over 200 platforms in a single app. Organize your backlog and wishlist, rate and review games, discover trending and top-rated titles, and use Your Roll to decide what to play next. Follow gamers, join communities, discuss games, and share games you discover anywhere online. GameRoll is your home for everything you play.

products.name: FixMyFX
products.tagline: Free FX fee calculator, plus how to reduce your FX costs
products.summaryZh: 免费外汇费用计算器，以及如何降低你的外汇成本
products.descriptionZh: 一款免费、无需注册的计算器，专为使用外币收款或付款的创始人打造。输入你的收入和支出，大致了解每年外汇手续费会花掉你多少钱，然后获得一份通俗易懂的省钱方案：以同一种货币收款和付款（例如 Wise 或 Airwallex 加一家本地银行）。通常外汇工具比较的是转账汇率；FixMyFX 关注的则是你的整个资金流，包括收入和支出。它完全在你的浏览器中运行：你的数据绝不会被收集或发送到服务器。
products.description: A free, no-sign-up calculator for founders who sell or spend in foreign currencies. Enter your revenue and spend, see roughly what FX fees cost you per year, then get a plain-English plan to minimise these costs: receive and spend in the same currency (e.g. Wise or Airwallex + a local bank). Typically FX tools compare transfer rates; FixMyFX looks at your whole flow, income and spending. It runs entirely in your browser: your numbers are never collected or sent to a server.

products.name: Wepin
products.tagline: A shared map for couples to pin places and keep memories
products.summaryZh: 情侣共享地图，标记地点，留住回忆
products.descriptionZh: Wepin是你和伴侣的私密地图。配对后，标记你们一起去过的每个地方，并为每个地点添加照片和笔记。随着时间推移，地图逐渐填满，成为你们关系的小小时间线。还有共享日历，包含每日连续记录、纪念日倒计时、想去的地方心愿单，以及一个保持联系的主屏幕小组件。iOS和Android均可免费下载。
products.description: Wepin is a private map for you and your partner. Pair up, pin every place you've been together and add photos and notes to each one. Over time your map fills in and becomes a little timeline of your relationship. There's also a shared calendar with daily streaks, anniversary countdowns, a wishlist for places you want to go next, and a home screen widget to stay connected. Free to download on iOS and Android.
